Summary: The HotpotQA dataset includes 18,089 examples in the train-easy split, 56,814 examples in the train-medium split, and 15,661 examples in the train-hard split, all of which are designated for training purposes. The dataset also includes a development set, test-distractor set, and test-fullwiki set, all containing hard multi-hop questions. The total number of examples in the dataset is 112,779.
